method.recipe_count: Count `git ls-files recipes/*.json` at the named lab commit.
method.alias_selection: Inspect only tracked top-level `results/<stem>.json` files: require direct parent `results`, exclude a stem containing `_run`, parse JSON, and retain an object only when `recipe == stem`. Nested Front Office receipts under `results/runs/` are intentionally outside this historical-alias predicate.
method.same_name_current_alias: A selected alias whose stem is a checked-in recipe stem.
method.orphan_alias: A selected alias whose stem is not a checked-in recipe stem.
method.modern_schema: Selected same-name alias with integer `receipt_schema_version >= 2`; all other selected same-name aliases are legacy.
method.appearing_warm: Selected same-name alias whose string `status` starts with `PASS` and does not contain `(cold)`, case-insensitive. This is a display predicate, not a promotion verdict.
method.active_runner_binding: Recursively search selected alias JSON values for exact equality with the active `run_recipe.py` SHA-256.
method.otr_carry_forward: Retain the unchanged profile/lane/Sage correction counts from the named read-only OTR snapshot in the prior census receipt.
